title: Keep train and wagon references bidirectional (Train - Wagon Coverage)

facts.note: Train files, wagon manifests and the wagons_not_in_train allow-list are identifiable by path/kind in the plan tree.
Any change to a train's participants, a wagon manifest, or the allow-list can create an orphan on either side.
Diff-level observer over train participants, the wagon manifest set/status, and the allow-list entries is needed to scope precisely.
Validator failures from the two coverage tests; these fire even when one side (trains or wagons) is empty.

fires: Planner adds a new non-draft wagon manifest, not listed in wagons_not_in_train, that no train lists in its participants.
Planner adds a wagon manifest while the plan has no trains at all, and the wagon is neither draft nor in wagons_not_in_train.
Planner adds a `wagon:` participant to a train for which no wagon manifest exists (including when the plan has no wagon manifests).
Planner renames or deletes a wagon manifest still referenced by a train participant.
Planner removes or edits a train so that a non-draft, non-allow-listed wagon is no longer in any train.
Planner promotes a wagon out of status:draft without adding it to any train, and it is not in wagons_not_in_train.
Planner removes from wagons_not_in_train a non-draft wagon that is not in any train.
doesNotFire: A wagon with status:draft is not yet in any train.
A wagon listed in the wagons_not_in_train allow-list is not in any train.
Edits to wagon content (features, WMBTs, acceptances) that do not change wagon identity, status, allow-list membership, or train participants.

given: A plan containing trains and/or wagon manifests (either side may be empty), plus the wagons_not_in_train allow-list
when: the planner adds, removes, renames, or changes the status of a wagon; adds, removes, or edits a train's participants; or changes the wagons_not_in_train allow-list
then: Keep train-wagon coverage bidirectional with no orphan: every wagon appears in at least one train's participants (wagon -> train), and every `wagon:` participant of a train has a wagon manifest (train -> wagon).
prefer: When creating a wagon, add it as a participant of at least one train in the same change.
When adding a `wagon:` participant to a train, create or point to an existing wagon manifest in the same change.
When renaming or removing a wagon, update every train participant that references it.
When removing a wagon from wagons_not_in_train or promoting it from draft, add it to a train in the same change.
avoid: Leaving an orphan on either side: a wagon in no train, or a train participant with no wagon manifest.
Adding a wagon to the wagons_not_in_train allow-list or marking it status:draft just to silence the coverage check.
unless: wagon -> train direction only: the wagon is listed in the wagons_not_in_train allow-list or has status:draft.
why: Bidirectional coverage means each side references the other with no orphan: every non-exempt wagon is reachable from a train, and every `wagon:` participant of a train resolves to a wagon manifest.
evidence: test_all_wagons_in_at_least_one_train passes (wagon -> train: every wagon appears in at least one train's participants, excepting allow-listed or draft wagons).
test_all_train_wagon_refs_exist passes (train -> wagon: every `wagon:` participant has a wagon manifest).
verifier_detail: Direction wagon -> train: requirement 'Every wagon must appear in at least one train's participants'; exceptions: wagons_not_in_train allow-list or status:draft; validator test_all_wagons_in_at_least_one_train.
Direction train -> wagon: requirement 'Every wagon: participant must have a wagon manifest'; no exceptions; validator test_all_train_wagon_refs_exist.
Term bidirectional_coverage: each side references the other, no orphan.
